dialogues.speaker: From Swords to Plowshares
dialogues.text: "A mechanical device originating from the nation known as 'Khaenri'ah,' here classified as a 'Field Tiller.'"

dialogues.speaker: From Swords to Plowshares
dialogues.text: "As it is not equipped with any form of cognitive simulation module and can only operate according to a limited set of preset instructions, it is presumed to possess little combat value. It should, however, remain suitable for basic agricultural use."
